original.question: What did non-serving groups do on the Sabbath?
original.passage:
11:5 and commanded them, “This is what you are to do: A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard the royal palace,
11:6 a third shall be at the gate of Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards. You are to take turns guarding the temple—
11:7 the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.

options.E: I can't tell from this passage

accepted_case.original_question: What did non-serving groups do on the Sabbath?

note: Replaces the misleading label “non-serving groups” with the passage’s clear description, “two divisions going off duty.” Asking what they were commanded to do preserves the intended assignment question without implying that the passage reports their carrying it out.
